title: Oscillatory replacement

mathematical_result.statement: For an invertible indefinite ORIGINAL-coordinate physical pair B with D=|det B| and kappa=sigma_min(B), if the exact Schur complement has a rank-two ORIGINAL-coordinate cross block M with Delta=sigma_1(M)sigma_2(M)>0, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 16 Delta^(-1/8)(D kappa)^(-1/4), uniformly over all independent cap-one input laws and arbitrary remaining blocks/affine terms.

premises.scope: Exact rank-two physical cross block between disjoint ORIGINAL-coordinate banks, arbitrary same-bank curvature and affine leakage; H_1/2 <= 8 Delta^-1/4.
Invertible indefinite ORIGINAL-coordinate physical pair plus Schur-remainder sqrt-small-ball receiver.

required_newest_source_application.application: On the strict-N3 family, the natural rank-three cut has row marginal alpha_p1=1, so D and D' fail at their marginal gates; exact rank three makes Z5=0, so D5 is unavailable.

partner_result_applied.application: For Q_def=2 sigma(X1Y1+X2Y2)+delta(X3^2+X4^2)+Z^2, the theorem gives <3.488 sigma^-2/3 delta^-1/3; choosing sigma=delta^-1/2 gives <3.488 uniformly.

stress_family.parameters: 0<eps<=1/2, sigma=eps^-3, hyperbolic physical pair B=[[0,eps],[eps,0]], diffuse rank-two exact Schur cross block with singular values sigma,sigma
stress_family.spectral_check: At least four eigenvalues have modulus >=1 by deterministic Weyl comparison; no matrix-to-law continuity is used.

next_step: Prove an exhaustive strict-N3 structural routing to a quantitatively strong indefinite pair+rank-two Schur packet, the partner definite-kernel packet, a grouped third-curvature packet, or an already-paid volume/ridge/hub/grouped-square/exact-null branch before any tiny local determinant is inverted.
